---
title: "Glossary"
subtitle: "Short definitions of the platform's terms"
---

Each entry links to the page where the term is explained in full. New to the platform? Start with [Key Concepts](key-concepts.qmd).

---

### Adjacency (domain adjacency)

The neighbouring domain *pairs* along a cluster's proteins. Used alongside domain overlap to measure cluster similarity, capturing arrangement rather than just membership. See [Scores & Metrics](scores-metrics.qmd).

### Assembly

The genome or metagenome a cluster was found in — an isolate genome, a metagenome-assembled genome (MAG), an environmental assembly, or a single validated BGC region. In the discovery platform, assemblies provide context (organism, source, taxonomy, biome) for the iBGCs they contain. See [Key Concepts](key-concepts.qmd).

### BGC (biosynthetic gene cluster)

A stretch of DNA whose genes work together to produce a natural product. See [Key Concepts](key-concepts.qmd).

### BGC class

A normalised label for the kind of biosynthetic machinery — Polyketide, NRPS, RiPP, Terpene, Saccharide, and hybrids. See [BGC Classes](bgc-classes.qmd).

### Biome

The environment an assembly came from, following the GOLD ecosystem classification (e.g. *Marine*, *Marine sediment*). See [Biome Ontology](biome-ontology.qmd).

### CHAMOIS

The tool that predicts a cluster's product chemistry (as [ChemOnt](chemont.qmd) classes) from its protein sequences. See [How the Data Is Built](how-data-is-built.qmd).

### ChemOnt

A hierarchical chemical-structure ontology (from ClassyFire) used to label predicted product chemistry. See [ChemOnt](chemont.qmd).

### Composite similarity

The weighted combination of domain overlap and adjacency overlap used to compare clusters. The basis for clustering, find-similar, and novelty. See [Scores & Metrics](scores-metrics.qmd).

### Detector

A BGC detection tool — **antiSMASH**, **GECCO**, or **SanntiS**. Each produces source predictions that are integrated into iBGCs. See [Key Concepts](key-concepts.qmd).

### Domain (protein domain)

A functional unit within a protein (InterPro/Pfam), e.g. a ketosynthase or adenylation domain. The platform's currency for comparing clusters. See [Protein Panel](protein-panel.qmd).

### Domain novelty

The fraction of an iBGC's domains that are unique within its own GCF. "—" for single-member families or clusters with no domains. See [Scores & Metrics](scores-metrics.qmd).

### GCF (gene cluster family)

A group of iBGCs with similar domain content — a "natural product family". Identified by a dotted path (e.g. `42.7.3`). See [Gene Cluster Families](gcf-explained.qmd).

### iBGC (integrated BGC)

The platform's central unit: overlapping source predictions on one contig consolidated into a single candidate cluster. See [Key Concepts](key-concepts.qmd).

### MIBiG

The curated database of experimentally validated BGCs. Loaded as **validated** iBGCs; the reference set novelty is measured against. See [MIBiG & Validated BGCs](mibig-validated.qmd).

### Novelty

`1 − similarity to the nearest validated cluster`. Higher = less like anything known. "—" when no validated reference exists. See [Scores & Metrics](scores-metrics.qmd).

### Partial

An iBGC that runs off the edge of its contig and may be incomplete. Placed onto the maps and scored by its nearest complete neighbours. See [UMAP](umap.qmd).

### Reference / Compare

The two iBGC detail panels: the **reference** is pinned (right-click → set as reference); the **compare** panel updates on each left-click. See [iBGC Detail](ibgc-detail.qmd).

### Region (assembly mode)

A processing mode where the input *is* a known BGC (one per contig); detectors are off. Used for validated sets. See [How the Data Is Built](how-data-is-built.qmd).

### Sequence search

Aligning a query protein against cluster proteins with phmmer, ranked by bitscore, identity, and coverage. See [Sequence Search](sequence-search.qmd).

### Shortlist

The browser-held set of iBGCs you collect, turned into a report and exports. Holds up to 1,000 iBGCs. See [Shortlists](shortlists.qmd).

### Source / collection

The dataset an assembly came from (e.g. a marine catalogue, BacDive, MIBiG). A filter and a roster column. See [What's in the Catalogue](datasets.qmd).

### Sørensen–Dice

The set-overlap coefficient used to score domain and adjacency similarity: `2·|A∩B| / (|A|+|B|)`. See [Scores & Metrics](scores-metrics.qmd).

### Submitted

An iBGC from an assembly *you* uploaded with [Load Asset](load-asset.qmd), shown in amber. See [Load Asset](load-asset.qmd).

### Type strain

An assembly corresponding to a strain deposited in a public culture collection (DSMZ, ATCC, …) — i.e. one you can obtain and culture. Flagged in the roster and detail panels. See [What's in the Catalogue](datasets.qmd).

### Validated

An iBGC from an experimentally characterised reference (e.g. MIBiG). The yardstick for novelty; novelty `0` by definition. See [MIBiG & Validated BGCs](mibig-validated.qmd).
